_doc.pooled_all: log((BC+.5)/(BW+.5))/1.702 over all 500 images (= Tab. S25 d'_pair)
_doc.pooled_vis: same over the 486 images with both shapes visible (the stratified images)
_doc.mh_terc_raw / mh_quint_raw: Mantel-Haenszel common OR across strata of 1:1 matched pairs = sum_t BC_t / sum_t BW_t (no 0.5 correction); identical to pooled_vis_raw for any stratification (each image is its own matched stratum), checked
_doc.std_terc / std_quint: size-standardised d'_pair: sum_t w_t log((BC_t+.5)/(BW_t+.5)) / 1.702, w_t = image share of stratum t (fixed across arms and bootstrap at the full-sample shares)
_doc.hetero: observed BC+BW share (%) vs the common-Delta maximum 100*(sigma(D/2)^2 + sigma(-D/2)^2) at the observed log-OR D; excess = observed - bound
_doc.bootstrap: 2000 image resamples (paired across arms, strata follow the image); seed 23; p = two-sided percentile bootstrap p (floor 1/(B+1))

points._doc: accuracy at an unbiased criterion Phi(d'/2); points = 100 [Phi(d'_CoT/2) - Phi(d'_Dir/2)]

criterion._doc: Tab. S23 (bias_sensitivity.json cot_vs_direct): c = -(z(H)+z(F))/2 on single-phrasing 'yes'; delta c < 0 = toward 'yes'

_doc.unit: (scene, phrasing): the original image and its identity-swapped twin asked the same question; truth of 'subject X is in front' is opposite; 400 units / model / arm
_doc.outcomes: BC both correct; SF subject called front in both images; SB subject called behind in both; BW both wrong. YY / NN = 'yes' / 'no' to both images (SF+front phrasing or SB+behind phrasing = YY)
_doc.cells: 2x2 cue cells (e13): vertical (front drawn lower = lower-is-closer congruent / front higher) x drawn area ratio front/back < 0.77 / >= 0.77; mh_raw = sum BC / sum BW (= pooled, matched pairs); std_cells = unit-share-weighted mean of within-cell log-ORs
_doc.vert_balanced: mean of the front-lower and front-higher log-ORs (the lower-is-closer cue enters with opposite signs and cancels under an additive logit); vert_component = half their difference (lower-is-closer reliance)
_doc.bootstrap: 2000 scene resamples (both phrasings and both images of a scene kept together); seed 232

glmm._doc: logit P(yes | image i, order s, arm a) = b_ia + s (Delta_{a,t(i)} + sigma_ua z_i)/2, (b_iD, b_iC) bivariate normal with tercile-specific means, z_i ~ N(0,1) shared across arms (image-specific sensitivity deviation), fixed Delta per arm x tercile; 10^3-node Gauss-Hermite; mean d' = tercile-averaged Delta / 1.702 (486 visible images); image bootstrap (200), cold-started; slope_sd in d' units. Weakly identified (two answers per image and arm): the slope SD and bias SD/correlation can sit at their bounds, so the mean d' depends on the normal random-effects assumption; exploratory.
